pages.text: Folder $(l)data/<mod>/rpmedicine/...$() in a world datapack:$(br)- $(l)items$() — what an item treats, time, level;$(br)- $(l)item_aliases$() — other mods' items as ours;$(br)- $(l)drugs$() — effects, doses, half-life, mg;
- $(l)hospital_blocks$() — which blocks are a bed, monitor, sterilizer, fridge, lab, oxygen;

- $(l)substances$() — alcohol, tobacco etc. from mods;$(br)- food composition — in the RP Culinary datapack;$(br)- $(l)damage_sources$() — which damage makes which wound;$(br)- $(l)mobs$() — mob injuries;$(br)- $(l)use_times$() — minimum use time (animation length).
Details — docs/datapack.md in the mod sources.
